agents_sdk.message: Can we buy the 5-litre gaskets from a supplier that doesn't have a food-grade certificate?
agents_sdk.reply:
**No, we cannot.**

According to Rasoi's **Purchase Policy (POL-PUR-001 §6.2)**:
> *"Parts that come into contact with food (gaskets, lids, body blanks and any other item marked food-contact in the item master) may be bought only from a supplier holding a valid food-grade certificate on file in Bahi. The certificate must be uploaded and checked before the first order is placed. An expired certificate counts as no certificate."*

This is also reinforced under **Supplier Policy (POL-SUP-003 §4.1 & §4.5)**. Since gaskets are specifically classified as food-contact parts, purchasing them from a supplier without a valid food-grade certificate on file is not permitted.
